correctness.rationale: For household size four and Exp(1) infectious periods, use q_j=(1+j ell)^-1, the exact Ball et al. beta_k/mu_k recurrences and triangular first-epidemic P_v recursion. For s=sum((4-v)P_v/4), U_v=C(4,v)(1-s)^v s^(4-v), and D=sum_{v=0}^3((4-v)/4)(P_v-U_v)mu_(4-v), independent SymPy algebra from those recurrences produced D=ell^2 pi^2(1-pi) H / [(1+ell)^15(1+2ell)^10(1+3ell)^5]. Independently reconstructed H has bidegree (13,28), and its 14x29 Bernstein-by-ell coefficient table has 403 strictly positive and 3 zero exact rational entries, no negative entries and no identically zero row. Generated UTF-8 TSV is 5925 bytes with Git blob SHA 5e8f08634a64383b469aa1c1eaca20379ff9b2b4, EXACTLY matching the pinned package's coefficient file, so all 406 coefficients and the polynomial identity are verified, not just the verifier log. A separate exact CTMC recursion at ell=1,pi=1/2 yields P=(1/16,1/16,1/16,7/64,45/64), mu=(1,3/2,13/6,143/48), and D=10262378043/68719476736>0. Bernstein positivity for ell>0 and 0<pi<1 proves the universal finite-Markovian n=4 inequality. The herd-immunity corollary follows from strict monotonicity of the vaccination threshold; it concerns tilde h_D, not the unrestricted h_D.
residual_risks: Exponential infectious periods and four-person homogeneous households only; no conclusion for all n or true unrestricted h_D.
